page.layout: Running head at top left, page number at top right. Below, one framed table of seven year groups, each with four names, the years printed in the left margin. Right margin: two italic marginal notes, the first beside 1400, the second beside 1405. Below the table: "V" at left and "Iarsh" at right, inside the frame.

l.i: Civitas transfigit cum episc. de Præ-fectura urbana & suburbana.

page.notes: The two italic marginal notes stand in the right margin, beside 1400 and 1405; they are given as type="foot" entries because they are set apart from the table. The years are printed in the left margin and are given as left-side notes on the first name of each group. The "1" of each year looks like a capital I in the scan; I have written it as 1. "Iarsh" and "V" stand inside the bottom frame line; I read the first as a catchword and the second as a signature mark, but that is uncertain. Printed "Wigbolt Everdts-sohn" uses a long s, transcribed as plain s. Printed "Iarges" in the last line is read as printed; it may be a misprint for Iarichs.
